--- stdout
CDL.Logical.TrueHoldWithReset
  Hold a true output for at least a duration; the engine-local clr input resets the hold

parameters:
  duration : Real = 0.0
      Minimum time, in seconds, that the output stays true once it turns true, unless clr clears it

inputs:
  u : Boolean
      Input signal: a true value turns the output true and starts the hold
  clr : Boolean
      Clear input: while true the output is false and the hold is cancelled

outputs:
  y : Boolean
      True while u is true and until duration has elapsed since the output turned true; false while clr is true

notes:
  (none)

links:
  (none)
--- stderr
